content.title: Chapter 70 - PERSONNEL RULES — Sec. 70-50.3. - Reclassifications.
content.summary:
Each fiscal year, the human resources department will evaluate changes to job descriptions
               to determine if a position should be reclassified in accordance with a policy established
               by the city manager.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023;
Ord. No. 4890
, § 3, 2-10-2025)
